email_subject: Application - Communications & Social Media Intern at Sailpeak
email_body:
Dear Sailpeak Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Communications & Social Media Intern role. Your focus on turning consulting projects into engaging stories and building employer branding resonates with my background in digital marketing and content creation.

In my freelance work, I've built and optimized websites, written SEO content, and used AI tools to streamline workflows. At Episto, I manage CMS content and create blog posts for client sites, which has sharpened my ability to write clearly and adapt to different brand voices. I also have experience with social media integration and event support from my time at Knowledge Experts.

I'm fluent in English and eager to bring my creative and structured approach to Sailpeak's communications. I'd love to help showcase your team's culture and expertise.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Sailpeak Team,

I am excited to apply for the Communications & Social Media Intern position at Sailpeak. Your firm's focus on digital transformation in Banking & Insurance, combined with the opportunity to craft compelling stories and organize team events, aligns perfectly with my skills and interests.

As a digital marketer with a technical background, I have hands-on experience in content creation, SEO, and social media integration. In my freelance work, I built and optimized websites for various clients, including developing a site for a Belgian youth chess champion where I implemented structured data and ran technical audits. At Episto, I manage CMS content for client websites, writing SEO blog posts and ensuring consistent brand messaging. My time at Knowledge Experts involved designing websites with social media integration and supporting event coordination, which taught me how to capture and share meaningful moments.

I am fluent in English and have a growing proficiency in Dutch, with Turkish as my native language. I am genuinely curious about AI and modern tech, and I regularly use AI tools to enhance my work. I am eager to bring my creative yet structured approach to Sailpeak, helping to elevate your brand voice and create engaging content that showcases your team's expertise and culture.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background can contribute to Sailpeak's communications goals. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
